_about: Advisories the security gate accepts for a limited time. Read by scripts/npm_audit_gate.py. An entry is not a fix. Each entry applies only to its exact advisory id and package, only until its expiry date, and only while the advisory stays out of production dependencies and npm offers no non-breaking fix. Adding or extending an entry requires the repository owner's decision. See docs/SECURITY-EXCEPTION-braces.md.
